players.title: Athletes
players.description: Everyone who trains at the box: profile, plan, contact and status.
sections.title: Disciplines
sections.description: The box's disciplines (CrossFit, HYROX, weightlifting…) with their class types.
agenda.title: Calendar
agenda.description: Classes, events and competitions at the box.
facilities.title: Rooms
facilities.description: The box's rooms and areas, with their hours and what's booked in them.
fees.title: Payments
fees.description: The box's charges and payments: who has paid and what's outstanding.
drills.title: Exercises
drills.description: The box's exercises, with explanations and video.
store.description: What the box sells to its athletes: apparel, gear, supplements and extras. Charged like any other payment.
shop.title: Box shop
shop.description: Apparel, gear and extras from the box. Paid like any other charge.
auth.invitation.subtitle: You've been invited to join the box.
auth.invitation.missingBody: The link isn't valid, has been revoked or belongs to another box.
positions.hint.director: Sees their disciplines: schedule, athletes, classes, rooms and leaderboard. No plans, box staff or payments.
positions.hint.coordinator: Like the head of programme, in their disciplines: schedule, athletes and classes.
positions.hint.delegate: Views classes, athletes and the leaderboard. Changes nothing.
positions.hint.physio: Assesses the body and leaves notes on the athletes they treat: those in their classes and those assigned to them.
positions.hint.scout: Assesses performance and leaves observation notes.
members.title: Box team
members.description: Who works at the box and in what role: admins, coaches and staff. Athletes have their own screens.
members.empty: There's no one on the box team yet.
members.roles.lastAdmin: You can't remove the box's last admin.
members.roles.hint.coach: Sees their classes and the athletes who come: check-in, programming and profiles.
members.roles.hint.guardian: Family of an under-18 athlete: sees their classes and payments.
members.roles.hint.staff: Box staff with a position: head of programme, coordination, physio, strength and conditioning or psychology.
members.roles.hint.athlete: Athlete with their own account: books classes and sees their WOD and progress. Access is given from their profile.
members.roles.sectionsHint: Head of programme and coordination only see the disciplines ticked. The ones they already coordinate count even if unticked.
members.roles.sectionsEmpty: The box has no disciplines yet.
members.inviteDrawer.description: They get a link, create their account and join the box with the chosen role.
members.inviteDrawer.roleHint.coach: Box coach: teaches classes and programs.
members.inviteDrawer.roleHint.guardian: Parent or guardian of an under-18 athlete.
members.inviteDrawer.roleHint.staff: Box staff who don't teach: they join with a position.
members.inviteDrawer.roleHint.athlete: Athletes are invited from their profile.
members.inviteDrawer.teamHint: Optional. On accepting, they join as a coach of that class type.
members.access.description: Tick what each role or position sees. Anything unticked doesn't show in their navigation or the API. The scope (the whole box, their disciplines, their classes or the athletes they treat) comes with the position and isn't changed here.
members.access.adminNote: Box admins see everything except Health, which only opens as an exception for whoever needs it. Athletes only see their own: classes, WOD, progress and payments.
members.access.overridesEmptyHint: Add someone from the box team and tick what they should see.
members.access.overrideSheet.empty: No one can have exceptions: athletes only see their own.
members.access.overrideSheet.adminHealth: Runs the box: sees everything except Health. Only Health can be opened to them, and each look is audited.
viewAs.title: View the box as…
viewAs.description: See the box through someone else's eyes: their screens, classes and plan. Your session doesn't change and any changes are logged under your name.
viewAs.empty: There's no one else at the box.
settings.title: Box settings
settings.description: The box's details and identity, how it gets paid and its website. What you change here, the whole box sees.
settings.forbidden: You can't edit this box's settings.
settings.general.title: Box details
settings.general.name: Box name
settings.general.timezoneHint: The class schedule is shown in this time zone, whatever the device's.
settings.activity.title: Box activity
settings.setup.description: {done} of {total} steps done. Get the box ready for your athletes.
settings.setup.colors: Choose the box's colours and identity
settings.identity.intro.title: Your box's app, unlike anyone else's
settings.identity.typography.options.cla: Serif headings. For boxes with history.
settings.identity.typography.options.ama: Rounded and friendly. For studios and family boxes.
settings.identity.icons.description: The stroke of every icon in the app.
Stroke and a soft fill in the box colour.
settings.identity.background.options.lis: Grey with a hint of the box colour.
settings.identity.background.options.ten: The box colour shows across the whole background.
settings.identity.background.options.deg: A veil of the box colour at the top.
settings.identity.background.options.tra: Fine dots in the box colour.
settings.identity.hero.description: The home header, where the box takes centre stage.
settings.identity.nav.options.claro.hint: White; the box colour on the active item.
settings.identity.nav.options.club.name: Box colour
settings.identity.nav.options.oscuro.hin: Almost black, with a tint of the box colour.
settings.identity.motto.description: A short line under the box name, on the home page and in invitations.
settings.identity.motto.label: Box motto
settings.identity.voice.title: Box voice
settings.identity.voice.description: How the box talks to its people across the app: greetings, notices, empty screens, classes and challenges. Money, health, errors, access and cancellations always sound the same: clear and professional.
settings.identity.bar.saved: Identity saved. The whole box can see it now.
settings.identity.boxLooks.description: A complete starting point for your box: colours, type, buttons, icons, background, navigation and voice. Then tweak whatever you like.
voices.hint.cercana: A good coach: warm, clear, explains the why.
settings.payments.title: How the box gets paid
settings.payments.description: Manually, the box records each payment. With Stripe, athletes pay in the app and the payment is recorded automatically.
settings.payments.providerHint.manual: Payments come in by bank transfer or at the front desk and someone records them in the app.
settings.payments.providerHint.stripe: Every pending charge has a pay button. The money goes to the box's Stripe account.
settings.payments.stripeAccountHint: The «acct_…» ID of the connected account. Stripe gives it when the box connects.
settings.payments.conflictPlatform: Stripe isn't set up on the platform yet. Until then, the box takes payments manually.
settings.payments.conflictAccount: To take payments through Stripe you need the box's connected account (acct_…).
settings.payments.howItWorks: Stripe is ready the same way Resend is for email: without keys, the box keeps taking payments manually; with keys and a connected account, online payment turns on when you choose Stripe.
settings.payments.stripeDescription: The box opens its own Stripe account, with its details and bank account. Stripe reviews it and lets you know if anything is missing.
settings.payments.statusHint.onboarding: Stripe still needs some of the box's details. Pick up the sign-up where you left it.
settings.payments.conflictNotReady: The box's Stripe account can't take payments yet: finish signing up in Stripe.
settings.accounting.connect.description: The box's charges, payments and cancellations reach Holded without typing them twice.
settings.accounting.settings.title: How charges are sent
settings.accounting.settings.description: What goes to Holded for each of the box's charges.
settings.accounting.settings.taxHint: If the box is a business, its plans carry VAT. Check the rate with your accountant.
settings.developers.description: The box website can show the shop products marked as public. It connects with a publishable key.
settings.developers.keyHint: It goes in the box website's code, in plain sight. It only gives access to what's public, nothing else.
settings.developers.noPublicProducts: No product on sale is marked for the box website. Do it from the product page, under «Where it shows».
settings.developers.endpointCatalog: The box (name, logo and colours) and its public products.
settings.developers.buying: Each product comes with a buy link: the athlete signs in to the app and buys it there.
settings.developers.snippetHint.html: Paste it into any page of the box website: it shows the products with photo, price and buy link.
settings.developers.confirmRotateBody: The current key stops working immediately: the box website won't show anything public until you put in the new one.
settings.developers.confirmDisableBody: The box website will stop showing anything public. You can turn it back on with a new key.
facilities.emptyHint: Add the box's rooms and areas to assign them to classes and spot overlaps.
facilities.notFound: That room doesn't exist or is no longer there.
facilities.detail.archivedHint: Archived room: it can't be picked for new classes. You can restore it any time.
facilities.detail.confirmArchiveBody: It stops showing when creating classes. Classes already using it stay as they are.
facilities.sheet.title: New room
facilities.hours.description: The times the room is available. They're shaded in the occupancy view.
facilities.week.count: {count, plural, =0 {No classes} one {# class} other {# classes}}
fees.charges.caption: Box charges
fees.charges.emptyHint: Charges come from plans every month, under Plans. You can also create a one-off charge.
fees.charges.manualNotice.title: The box takes payments manually
fees.charges.manualNotice.body: For athletes to pay their plans in the app, connect a payment gateway such as Stripe. Payments are recorded automatically and the money goes to the box's account.
fees.plans.caption: Plans
fees.planSheet.title: New plan
fees.charge.description: A one-off charge for one person, with or without a plan.
fees.charge.descriptionFor: A charge for {name}, with or without a plan.
fees.mine.title: My payments
fees.mine.description: What you owe the box and what you've already paid.
fees.mine.manualHint: The box records payments manually: pay by bank transfer or at the front desk and it'll show here as paid.
fees.mine.emptyHint: When the box issues you a charge, you'll see it here.
fees.connections.gateway.description: To take payments online, the box needs to connect a payment gateway. We use Stripe.
fees.connections.gateway.benefits.pay: Athletes pay by card or direct debit in the app, on their phone too, in a minute.
fees.connections.gateway.benefits.auto: Every payment is recorded against its charge automatically: no one logs or reconciles it by hand.
fees.connections.gateway.benefits.money: The money goes straight to the box's Stripe account. The platform never touches it.
fees.connections.gateway.benefits.cost: Stripe charges a fee on each payment. The box sees it in its Stripe dashboard.
fees.connections.gateway.step2: The box opens its Stripe account, with its details and bank account.
fees.connections.gateway.step3: The box turns on online payments.
fees.connections.gateway.live: Online payments on: every pending charge has a pay button for the athlete.
fees.connections.gateway.platformMissing: Once the platform has its Stripe keys, the box will open its account from here in a few minutes.
fees.connections.gateway.noPermission: Box admins connect Stripe from Settings, Payments.
fees.connections.accounting.description: Connect the box's invoicing tool and charges arrive on their own. We're starting with Holded.
fees.connections.accounting.benefits.doc: Each charge goes to Holded as an invoice or receipt in the payer's name: the athlete or their family.
fees.connections.accounting.benefits.can: Cancelling a charge cancels its draft in Holded.
fees.connections.accounting.noPermission: Box admins connect Holded from Settings, Accounting.
store.counter.description: For someone at the box buying in person. It lowers the stock and opens their charge; you collect it afterwards.
store.counter.chargeHint: The order is paid through a charge in Payments: collect it from the order page.
store.orders.emptyHint: When an athlete buys something, or you sell at the desk, it'll show up here.
store.products.emptyHint: Add a T-shirt, knee sleeves or a supplement and put it on sale.
store.sheet.description: Price, sizes or options with their stock, who it's sold to and whether it shows on the box website.
store.sheet.audienceHint: In the app, only athletes in that scope see it.
store.sheet.visibilityPublic: In the app and on the box website
store.sheet.visibilityHint.members: For internal things: a box event, an outing.
store.sheet.visibilityHint.public: It appears in the public catalogue the box website reads (Settings, Box website).
store.sheet.memberPrice: Price for athletes with a plan (optional)
store.sheet.memberPriceHint: Paid by athletes with an active plan. Empty: same price for everyone.
store.sheet.memberPriceTooHigh: The plan price can't be higher than the regular price.
shop.cart.description: One order per person, so the box knows who each thing is for.
shop.cart.noteHint: Your size, an allergy, anything the box should know.
shop.cart.paymentHint: When you order, it's added to your payments. You pay however the box has set up.
shop.cart.confirmBody: {count, plural, one {One order} other {# orders}} for {names} totalling {total}. It's added to your payments and the box gets it ready.
shop.orders.manualHint: The box records payments manually: pay by bank transfer or at the front desk.
shop.orders.readyHint: Ready: pick it up at the box.
shop.orders.confirmCancelBody: Order {code} is cancelled and removed from your payments.
shop.spotlight.title: Box shop
shop.noBeneficiaries: The shop is for the box's athletes and the families of under-18s.
shop.noBeneficiariesHint: If you think you should see it, talk to the box.
shop.emptyHint: When the box puts something on sale, you'll see it here.
storeOrder.cancelledRefund: Order cancelled. Refund {amount} to the athlete.
storeOrder.chargeHint: It's paid through a charge in Payments: paying by Stripe or manually closes it in both places.
palette.placeholder: Search athletes, classes, screens or actions
errors.invitation_expired: The invitation has expired. Ask the box for a new one.
errors.quota_exceeded: The box has used up this week's AI proposals. They reset on Monday.
errors.ai_unavailable: AI proposals aren't available at this box.
errors.suggestion_limit: Your box has sent a lot of suggestions in the last 24 hours. Try again tomorrow.
audit.player.athlete_linked: Athlete given access to their profile
audit.view_as.started: Viewed the box as someone else
roadmap.onlyAdmins: Only box admins can suggest improvements and see the roadmap.
roadmap.open.description: Vote for the ones that matter most to you: one vote per box. The most voted get looked at first.
roadmap.mine.title: Box suggestions
roadmap.mine.description: What your box has asked the platform for and where it stands. Only box admins see it.
roadmap.mine.empty: Your box hasn't suggested anything yet
roadmap.form.description: The platform team reads it. If it fits, it's published without the box's name so other clubs can vote.
roadmap.form.titleHint: One sentence. For example: Export athletes to Excel.
settings.identity.intro.body: Logo, colours, type, buttons, icons, background, home header, navigation, corners, motto and voice. What you choose shows instantly across the app, only for you, until you save.
settings.identity.colors.description: The main colour tints buttons, links and the home header; the secondary, the stripe and the ring around the logo.
settings.identity.colors.secondaryHint: Header stripe, logo ring, stripes and band.
settings.identity.hero.noLogo: Upload the logo to see it as the header background. Until then, it's plain.
settings.identity.hero.options.escudo.hi: The logo, large, in the background.
settings.logo.title: Logo
voices.hint.vestuario: Energy and box slang. Never in sensitive moments.
